context_title:
Summarize all the previous points in a single sentence :

Create a complete, productionready, singlefile HTML document implementing a mobilefirst documentation link selector application. The document must be fully selfcontained, using only the Tailwind CSS CDN and no external frameworks, libraries, or assets beyond the specified CDN. The language of the user interface must be Hungarian. The visual design must be a pure black background with glassmorphism panels, custom checkboxes, and subtle interactive feedback. Every element, style rule, data entry, event handler, and behavioral detail listed below must be implemented exactly and completely with no omissions, placeholders, or simplifications.
Begin by writing the full HTML5 doctype and root element:<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="hu" class="dark">Inside the <head>:
•  Set charset to UTF8.
•  Set viewport meta to width=devicewidth, initialscale=1.0, maximumscale=1.0, userscalable=no, viewportfit=cover.
•  Set document title to “Exa Documentation Selector”.
•  Add Apple mobile webapp capable meta set to “yes”.
•  Add Apple mobile webapp statusbarstyle meta set to “blacktranslucent”.
•  Add themecolor meta set to “000000”.
•  Load Tailwind CSS from the exact CDN URL .
•  Immediately after the Tailwind script, include an inline configuration script that enables darkMode as ‘class’ and extends the theme with the following custom colors under brand: 50 = ‘f4f4f5’, 100 = ‘e4e4e7’, 500 = ‘71717a’, 900 = ‘18181b’, 950 = ‘09090b’, accent = ‘3b82f6’. Extend fontFamily.sans to the exact array ['applesystem', 'BlinkMacSystemFont', '"SF Pro Display"', '"SF Pro Text"', 'Inter', 'sansserif'].
•  Follow with a <style> block containing every rule exactly as specified:
	•  Universal selector  with webkittaphighlightcolor: transparent and userselect: none.
	•  body backgroundcolor 000000, color f4f4f5, and fontfeaturesettings "cv02", "cv03", "cv04", "cv11".
	•  .glasspanel background rgba(18, 18, 20, 0.75), backdropfilter and webkitbackdropfilter blur(20px), border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08).
	•  .glasscard background rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.5), border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), transition all 0.2s cubicbezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
	•  .glasscard:active transform scale(0.985), background rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.8).
	•  .customcheckbox width and height 22px, borderradius 7px, border 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transition all 0.2s ease, display flex, alignitems and justifycontent center.
	•  .itemselected .customcheckbox backgroundcolor and bordercolor both ffffff.
	•  .itemselected bordercolor rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), background rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.4).
	•  .customcheckbox svg opacity 0, transform scale(0.5), transition all 0.2s ease.
	•  .itemselected .customcheckbox svg opacity 1, transform scale(1), color 000000.
	•  Custom scrollbar rules: ::webkitscrollbar width 4px; track background 000000; thumb background 27272a, borderradius 2px.
Proceed to the <body> element with exact classes minhscreen flex flexcol pb36 antialiased selection:bgwhite selection:textblack.
Construct the sticky header as the first child:
•  Classes: sticky top0 z40 glasspanel borderb borderwhite/10 px4 pt12 pb4 sm:pt6.
•  Inside a maxw3xl mxauto flex flexcol gap4 container:
	•  A flex row with itemscenter justifybetween containing:
		•  Left side: flex itemscenter gap3 with a w3 h3 roundedfull bgwhite animatepulse indicator followed by an h1 with classes textxl fontsemibold trackingtight textwhite and text content “Exa Docs Hub”.
		•  Right side: a span with id counterBadge, classes textxs fontmono px2.5 py1 roundedfull bgwhite/10 textwhite/70 border borderwhite/5, initial text “0 / 0”.
	•  A relative search container holding an input with id searchInput, type text, placeholder “Cím keresése…”, and classes wfull bgneutral900/90 textwhite placeholderneutral500 textsm roundedxl px10 py3 border borderwhite/10 focus:outlinenone focus:borderwhite/40 transitionall.
	•  An absolutepositioned search SVG icon (exact path data for magnifying glass) with classes w4 h4 absolute left3.5 top3.5 textneutral500.
	•  A flex row with itemscenter justifybetween textxs fontmedium textneutral400 containing:
		•  Two buttons: id selectAllBtn text “Mind kijelölése” and id deselectAllBtn text “Kijelölés törlése”, both with classes px3 py1.5 roundedlg bgneutral900 border borderwhite/10 active:bgneutral800 transition.
		•  A span with id visibleCount and class textneutral500.
Next construct the main content area:
•  Classes flex1 maxw3xl wfull mxauto px4 mt4.
•  Inside it a single empty div with id linksContainer and class spacey2.
Then construct the fixed bottom bar:
•  Classes fixed bottom0 left0 right0 z50 glasspanel bordert borderwhite/10 p4 pb8 sm:pb4.
•  Inside a maxw3xl mxauto flex itemscenter justifybetween gap4 container:
	•  A flexcol block with a textxs textneutral400 span “Kiválasztva” and an id selectedSummary span with classes textlg fontbold textwhite fontmono initial text “0 elem”.
	•  A button with id copyBtn, classes flex1 sm:flexnone px6 py3.5 roundedxl bgwhite textblack fontsemibold textsm active:scale95 transitionall duration200 flex itemscenter justifycenter gap2 shadow[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.15)], containing an exact copy SVG icon and a span “Linkek másolása”.
Add a toast notification element:
•  id toast, classes fixed top6 left1/2 translatex1/2 z50 glasspanel px5 py3 rounded2xl textxs fontsemibold textwhite border borderwhite/20 shadow2xl opacity0 pointereventsnone transitionall duration300 transform translatey[10px].
Finally place a single <script> block containing the complete application logic. Inside the script:
Define a constant array linkData that holds exactly 160 objects. Each object must contain a title string and a url string with the precise values listed below, in the exact order given (no additions, deletions, or alterations):
Immediately after the array, create a mutable items array by mapping linkData so each element receives an additional numeric id equal to its index and a boolean selected initialized to false.
Cache the following DOM references once: linksContainer, searchInput, counterBadge, selectedSummary, visibleCount, and toast.
Implement the function renderList:
•  Read the current lowercased, trimmed value of the search input.
•  Clear the container’s innerHTML.
•  Initialize a visible counter to 0.
•  Iterate over every item in items. Skip any item whose title does not contain the query (caseinsensitive). For every matching item:
	•  Increment the visible counter.
	•  Create a div with classes glasscard p4 roundedxl flex itemscenter gap3.5 cursorpointer plus the conditional class itemselected when the item’s selected flag is true.
	•  Set a dataid attribute to the item’s id.
	•  Populate the div’s innerHTML with a customcheckbox div containing the exact checkmark SVG path, followed by a span with classes textsm fontmedium textneutral200 leadingsnug breakwords whose text content is the HTMLescaped title.
	•  Attach a click listener that calls toggleSelection with the item’s id.
	•  Append the card to the container.
•  Update the visibleCount text to “${visible} találat” when a query is active, otherwise empty.
•  Call updateStats.
Implement toggleSelection(id):
•  Invert the selected flag of the corresponding item.
•  Locate the card by dataid and add or remove the itemselected class accordingly.
•  Call updateStats and triggerHaptic.
Implement updateStats:
•  Count the number of items whose selected flag is true.
•  Set counterBadge text to “${selectedCount} / ${items.length}”.
•  Set selectedSummary text to “${selectedCount} elem”.
•  If the WebKit message handler selectionChanged exists, post a message containing the selected count.
Implement escapeHtml(text) by creating a temporary div, assigning the text to its textContent, and returning its innerHTML.
Implement triggerHaptic that calls navigator.vibrate(10) when available.
Implement showToast(message) that sets the toast text, removes the opacity0 / pointereventsnone / translatey[10px] classes, adds opacity100 and translatey0, then after 2500 ms restores the hidden state classes.
Attach a click listener to selectAllBtn that sets selected = true on every item that either has an empty query or matches the current query, then calls renderList and triggerHaptic.
Attach a click listener to deselectAllBtn that sets selected = false on every item, then calls renderList and triggerHaptic.
Attach an input listener to searchInput that calls renderList.
Attach a click listener to copyBtn that:
•  Collects the urls of all selected items.
•  If the collection is empty, shows the toast “Nincs kijelölve egyetlen elem sem!” and returns.
•  Joins the urls with newline characters.
•  Creates a temporary textarea, inserts the joined text, selects it, and attempts document.execCommand('copy').
•  Falls back to navigator.clipboard.writeText when available.
•  If the WebKit message handler copyToClipboard exists, posts the joined text.
•  Calls triggerHaptic and shows the toast “${selectedUrls.length} link másolva a vágólapra!”.
Conclude the script by invoking renderList() once to populate the initial view.
The finished HTML file must be syntactically valid, contain every listed style rule, every listed data entry, every listed event handler, every listed Hungarian string, and every listed visual and behavioral detail with zero truncation, abstraction, or substitution. Output only the complete HTML source.I want to upgrade the existing singlefile documentation link selector application so that its complete visual design, surface rendering, interaction model, and component system are replaced by the full production GlassKit v1.0.0 library (the exact singlefile JavaScript source provided) while preserving every functional behavior, data set, Hungarian UI string, selection logic, search filtering, clipboard copy path, haptic feedback, WebKit bridge, counter, toast, and list item exactly as previously specified, resulting in a fully working, productionready single HTML file that mounts GlassKit, registers all its custom elements, applies genuine glass surfaces with correct blur/refraction/specular/edge treatment, and renders the entire interface exclusively through GlassKit primitives and effects with zero residual Tailwind, CSSglass, or placeholder styling.
Construct the upgraded document as follows.
Begin with a complete HTML5 skeleton whose <head> contains only the charset, viewport, title, Apple mobilewebapp and themecolor meta tags, and a single inline <script> that embeds the entire unabridged GlassKit factory (the full source beginning with the UMD wrapper and ending with the customelement registration and return GlassKit). Immediately after that script, insert a second inline script that performs GlassKit.mount(document.body, { maxDPR: 2, debug: false, glassAppearance: 'regular' }) once the DOM is ready.
Replace the previous Tailwinddriven layout with the following GlassKitnative structure, using only the custom elements and APIs defined inside the provided GlassKit source:
•  A root gkwindowframe that fills the viewport and hosts a gkglasscontainer configured with regular variant, default spacing 40, blur radius 28, edge thickness 0.22, refraction 1.0, IOR 1.45, and chromatic aberration matching the regular preset.
•  Inside the container place a sticky top gktoolbar that contains:
	•  a leading gktoolbaritem holding a pulsing indicator and the exact title string “Exa Docs Hub”,
	•  a trailing gkbadge bound to the selection counter (format “N / total”),
	•  a fullwidth gksearchfield whose placeholder is the exact Hungarian string “Cím keresése…”,
	•  two gkbutton instances labelled “Mind kijelölése” and “Kijelölés törlése” that invoke the same selectall / deselectall logic previously defined.
•  The main scrollable region must be a gkscrollview whose content is a gklist of gklistrow elements. Each row is generated from the identical 160entry linkData array (titles and URLs unchanged). Every row exposes:
	•  a custom leading checkbox surface realized as a small circular or roundedrect gkglasscontainer whose selected state is driven by the row’s selected flag and which renders the checkmark via a gkicon,
	•  the exact title text,
	•  pressscale interaction (0.96–0.98) and haptic vibration on toggle,
	•  the same clicktotoggle, searchfilter visibility, and WebKit selectionChanged postMessage behavior.
•  The fixed bottom action bar is realized as a second gkglasscontainer (or gktoolbar) that shows the Hungarian “Kiválasztva” label, a live gkbadge displaying “N elem”, and a primary gkbutton labelled “Linkek másolása” that performs the identical multiURL newlinejoined clipboard write (including the temporary textarea fallback, navigator.clipboard, and WebKit copyToClipboard bridge) and then displays a transient toast via a GlassKit alert or popover whose text matches the original success / emptyselection messages.
All visual styling previously supplied by Tailwind classes or the custom .glasspanel / .glasscard / .customcheckbox rules must be removed. Surface appearance, blur, refraction, specular highlights, edge lighting, press dent, contrastlift, and qualitytier adaptation are obtained exclusively by calling the GlassKit Glass, Shape, and Renderer APIs that are already present in the embedded library. Background extensions, safearea insets, and scrolledge effects defined by GlassKit must be applied where the layout meets the viewport edges.
The JavaScript logic that builds the items array, implements renderList, toggleSelection, updateStats, escapeHtml, triggerHaptic, showToast, and the four event listeners remains functionally identical; only the DOM construction and class/style manipulation are rewritten to create, update, and destroy the corresponding GlassKit custom elements and to keep their properties (selected, title, disabled, etc.) in sync with the data model.
The finished file must contain:
1.  the complete, unmodified GlassKit source inside the first script tag,
2.  the original 160entry linkData array with every title and URL preserved,
3.  every Hungarian string exactly as specified,
4.  every behavioral sideeffect (selection count, clipboard, haptic, WebKit bridges, toast timing),
5.  zero external network requests beyond the initial page load,
6.  zero residual Tailwind or handwritten glass CSS.
Success is defined as a single HTML document that, when opened in a modern browser, mounts GlassKit, renders a fully interactive glass documentation selector whose surfaces exhibit the authentic GlassKit refraction, blur, specular, and edge treatment, and whose selection, search, and copy operations behave identically to the prior implementation while using only GlassKit primitives.
Send back the complete code with all the fixes. Fix each of the listed errors one by one, making sure to actually correct them so that there are 0 errors remaining. Keep the original imports, since the files exist. Write out every single character; do not abbreviate anything. Fix every error. There must be exactly one file. Do not write anything else; just output the complete code, and it must not contain any comments. Never, under any circumstances, use simplified, substitute, dummy, simulated, or fake code. Write the entire file as complete, unabridged, productionready code in a single code block. It must be 100% errorfree, a complete, errorfree file, and must be submitted as a downloadable file. These requirements are mandatory and must be strictly adhered to. If no list of errors is provided, you must find all the errors and fix them. If there were comments in the original code, delete them. And most importantly: YOU MUST NEVER SIMPLIFY!
